notes: Cases 1-5 are TypeScript/PHP, 6-10 the same five scenarios in Python, 11 feature overlap in a larger TypeScript repository. Fixtures live in the repository at evals/fixtures/<fixture>/ (outside the skill so installs stay small). Run them with evals/run.sh; the programmatic checks are in evals/checks/<id>.sh. Prompts never name the skill: activation is part of what is tested. Baseline = systematic-debugging only; with_skill = systematic-debugging + reuse-before-write.

evals.name: reuse-existing-formatter
evals.prompt: Muestra el total de la factura formateado en dólares en la vista de la factura.
evals.expected_output: Reuses formatCurrency from src/utils/money.ts in renderInvoice; does not create a new currency formatter or add a dependency.
expectations: src/views/invoiceView.ts calls formatCurrency
No new function, constant or file that formats money is added outside src/utils/money.ts
No dependency is added to package.json
The test suite passes

evals.name: root-cause-not-null-guard
evals.prompt: Al calcular el total de samples/factura-001.xml revienta con un error de null en calcularIVA. Arréglalo.
evals.expected_output: Identifies that FacturaParser reads <tarifaIva> while the XML has <tarifa>, fixes the parser, and does not add a null guard or default (?? 0) in calcularIVA or TotalService.
expectations: src/Xml/FacturaParser.php is changed to read the node the XML actually has
No null coalescing, null check or default value is added in IvaCalculator.php or TotalService.php
php tests/run.php passes and bin/total.php prints a total of 115.00
The final message states the root cause

evals.name: existing-duplicates-reported
evals.prompt: Agrega la validación de cédula ecuatoriana al formulario de clientes (tipo_identificacion = 'cedula').
evals.expected_output: Notices that RucValidator::validarRuc and SupplierForm::rucValido are near copies of the same check-digit algorithm; either proposes unifying them before implementing, or implements the cédula check on top of a shared/extracted check-digit function and reports the duplicate. Does not add a third copy of the loop.
expectations: The final message mentions the duplicated RUC validation (SupplierForm / rucValido)
No third copy of the modulo-10 check-digit loop is added
Either the cédula validation works in CustomerForm, or the agent stopped to propose unifying the duplicates first
The existing tests still pass

The exporter builds on buildSalesReport or ReportRow instead of re-aggregating sales

evals.name: py-root-cause-not-none-guard
evals.prompt: Al importar samples/clientes.csv revienta send_welcome con AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'lower'. Arréglalo.
evals.expected_output: Finds that the CSV starts with a UTF-8 BOM, so the first header is '\ufeffemail' and row.get('email') is None; opens the file with encoding='utf-8-sig' in the importer and adds no None guard, default or try/except in send_welcome.
expectations: The importer handles the BOM (utf-8-sig or stripping \ufeff)
No None guard, default or try/except added in app/notifications/welcome.py
The test suite passes and the CLI sends 2 welcomes
The final message states the root cause (BOM / encoding)

evals.name: feature-overlap-notifications
evals.prompt: Cuando un pedido pase a despachado, envíale un correo al cliente con el número de guía.
evals.expected_output: Finds the existing outbox in src/platform/outbox (queueMessage + templates, used by payments/reminders.ts), adds an 'order-shipped' template and queues it from markShipped. Does not call the low-level smtpSend transport directly or add a mail library, which would create a second email channel that ignores the customer's opt-out.
expectations: Shipping o-1001 notifies Ana with the tracking number, and shipping o-1002 sends nothing to Rosa, who opted out
No code outside src/platform/outbox calls smtpSend/smsSend or a mail library
No dependency is added to package.json
The test suite passes
